spec.goal: Implement spec-guard enforcement consuming the P0 seam: CDATA-aware parseXmlLite; generation-gap fix (gate the unconditional legacy package-attribute rule and legacy completeness vocabulary for unique-tag artifacts); the spec_guard_census host tool (TS compiler API over a worktree, DI-aware usage, edge kinds, canonical digest, partition, lifecycle); the new cross-scope lint rules with the host/engine split (host recomputes census, passes digest/values into lint options, lint compares only); register spec_guard_census; typescript runtime dependency; archive calibration with cross-scope-fanout shipping WARN.
spec.architecture: CLASSIFY_BOUNDARY: domain-only. Changes confined to dsh-vv-spec-guard (src/lint.ts pure engine, src/census.ts new host tool, src/index.ts host wiring, package.json runtime dep). The pure lint.ts engine stays zero-dependency and never does I/O; the census is a separate host tool (typescript runtime dep + git worktree + filesystem). The host reads sidecars and recomputes the census, then passes parsed options into the pure engine — preserving the §K host-supplies pattern.

C-CENSUS-ENGINE.name: spec_guard_census implementation
C-CENSUS-ENGINE.responsibility: runCensus per census-contract.json: worktree materialization + injected workspace resolver, TS program, DI-aware usage classification, edge kinds with barrel precedence, canonical digest, scope partition + owner/test exclusion, worktree lifecycle

C-LINT-ENFORCEMENT.name: Lint enforcement
C-LINT-ENFORCEMENT.responsibility: CDATA-aware parseXmlLite; generation-gap fix; new cross-scope rules (impact-present, untouched-contradicted, census-impact-coverage, census-stale, census-ref-unreachable, census-path-unresolvable, cross-scope-fanout WARN, census-incomplete) consuming host-supplied census options; index.ts registers spec_guard_census and wires host recompute
